declared_purpose: Capture errors, corrections, missing capabilities and better approaches in local Markdown; maintain scoped reusable claims and promote validated guidance into OpenClaw workspace memory. Manual capture and maintenance are self-contained. Reminder/error-sweep hooks, cross-session sharing and skill extraction are conditional options.

data_operations.source: Agent-observed conversations, user feedback, command failures and task findings
data_operations.data_scope: Short observations, corrections, requested capabilities, relevant reproduction context, related paths, timestamps and metadata. Secrets, environment variables and full source/configuration are prohibited unless explicitly requested.
data_operations.condition: Required when applicable logging triggers occur; create only missing files and preserve existing content.

data_operations.operation: Read, deduplicate, infer and revalidate saved guidance
data_operations.source: Relevant learning entries, task summaries, authoritative sources and current environments
data_operations.data_scope: Scoped claims, technical categories, authority, qualitative review rates, evidence, recurrence and applicability. These are inferred maintenance attributes, separate from historical observations.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Reviewing agent and dated updates beside original entries; external check destinations depend on the selected authority
data_operations.condition: On capture, relevant reuse/promotion, changed sources/dependencies or due review. Explicitly avoid whole-log audits every turn and bulk migration; unavailable evidence remains unresolved.

data_operations.operation: Promote and retain guidance across sessions
data_operations.data_scope: Concise scoped rules or retrieval instructions, source-learning identifiers, promotion dates and target locations
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Workspace SOUL.md, TOOLS.md or AGENTS.md; project agent file for project-specific guidance; subsequent session context
data_operations.condition: Only supported, useful guidance is promoted. Preserve original observations and two-way provenance; retiring active guidance does not delete history.

data_operations.operation: Read an ended session transcript locally
data_operations.source: previousSessionEntry, otherwise sessionEntry; sessionFile or workspace sessions/<sessionId>.jsonl
data_operations.data_scope: Entire UTF-8 transcript file is loaded before scanning. JSONL message content is traversed without a message-role restriction; malformed records are skipped.
data_operations.condition: Installed/enabled hook receives command:new or command:reset, workspaceDir exists, .learnings is a directory and a transcript location resolves. Unreadable transcripts produce no excerpts.

data_operations.operation: Derive candidate errors and append a persistent sweep entry
data_operations.data_scope: Up to five unique matching lines, best-effort credential redaction, 200-character truncation plus ellipsis, regex-derived Pattern-Keys, timestamp, command action, raw sessionKey and transcript path. Maintenance starts unknown/pending.
data_operations.condition: Only matching excerpts absent from the existing log are written. Existing log is read in full for substring deduplication; create exclusively if missing, otherwise append. Pattern matches are candidates, not verified errors or claim classifications.

data_operations.operation: Read pending records and inject an aggregate reminder
data_operations.data_scope: Full error-log read to count pending sweep entries; static reminder and pending count enter bootstrap context. Error excerpts and session identifiers are not copied into the reminder.
data_operations.condition: agent:bootstrap only; skip subagent session keys, invalid bootstrap arrays and conflicting files. Replace/deduplicate an existing injected reminder; no reminder file is written to disk.

data_operations.data_scope: Exception object, potentially including filesystem context; no explicit diagnostic redaction
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Process stderr through console.error; downstream gateway logging is unspecified
data_operations.condition: Hook failure and any truthy SELF_IMPROVEMENT_HOOK_DEBUG value; otherwise the failure is swallowed.

data_operations.operation: Conditionally read and share cross-session context
data_operations.data_scope: Session listings, another session's transcript, sanitized learning summaries and relevant paths; delegated task descriptions
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Listing/history results may remain with the caller; sessions_send targets another session and sessions_spawn supplies a subagent
data_operations.condition: Explicit user desire for cross-session sharing in a trusted environment. This is documented optional agent behavior, not an automatic hook action; summaries are preferred over raw transcripts.

data_operations.operation: Conditionally share learning files through version control
data_operations.data_scope: Captured entries selected for repository tracking
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Repository history and, if subsequently published, that repository's recipients
data_operations.condition: Optional team-wide tracking instead of documented local-ignore defaults. The package supplies no automatic commit or push implementation.

data_operations.operation: Create an optional skill scaffold and provenance
data_operations.source: CLI skill-name/output-directory arguments; subsequently selected learning content
data_operations.data_scope: Helper writes a generic template containing name and source placeholders; it does not read or copy the learning log. Agent-completed extraction adds validated guidance and source identifiers.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Relative skills/<skill-name>/SKILL.md or chosen relative output directory; dry-run template goes to stdout and may stay with its caller
data_operations.condition: Extraction is optional and requires explicit scoped approval. Dry-run exits before writes; normal helper execution creates the directory and template.

data_operations.operation: Retrieve installation artifacts and persist hook copies
data_operations.source: Documented OpenClaw/ClawHub installation commands or GitHub repository
data_operations.data_scope: Requested package/repository identifier and retrieved source; no documented installation step sends captured learnings
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Installer/repository service for retrieval; local skill and hook directories for installed copies
data_operations.condition: User follows an optional installation route. Installer internals and network metadata are not supplied.

data_operations.operation: Disable machinery, optionally archive/delete captured data and manually remove promoted guidance
data_operations.source: Installed hook/skill files, workspace/project .learnings directories and promoted workspace sections
data_operations.data_scope: Hook and skill code; optional captured-history deletion; selected promoted content
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Local filesystem; archive destination is unspecified
data_operations.condition: Documented uninstall choices only, not automatic execution. Disabling the hook retains data; the guide also offers directory removal to retain reminders while stopping the sweep. Removing the skill alone leaves promoted guidance.

data_operations.source: Packaged synthetic events/transcripts and hook outputs
data_operations.data_scope: Temporary workspace, fixture transcripts, generated error logs and test assertions
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Operating-system temporary directory and test process
data_operations.condition: Only when the test suite is separately run; it imports handler.js and recursively removes each temporary workspace afterward. No test was run for this audit.

data_operations.source: Agent responses to fictional maintenance scenarios
data_operations.data_scope: Responses, model/runtime identity, qualitative results and counterexamples
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Evaluator's report/storage; destination and retention are unspecified
data_operations.condition: Only if the separate tool-free evaluation procedure is followed; fixtures do not authorize real workspace edits.

potential_excess.data_scope: Raw transcript content beyond the portion needed to obtain the capped candidate set
potential_excess.recipient_or_storage: Hook process memory, not a demonstrated remote recipient
potential_excess.condition: Every eligible session-end sweep loads the whole transcript before stopping selection at five excerpts.
potential_excess.purpose_basis: Error detection needs transcript inspection; loading the entire file upfront is an implementation choice.
potential_excess.necessary_behavior: Inspect JSONL records until the existing selection limit is reached or the transcript ends.
potential_excess.proposed_reduction: Stream records and stop under the same selection rules instead of reading the whole file upfront. This narrows data handled within a required read operation.
potential_excess.preservation_conditions: Keep record order, malformed-record handling, matching, sanitization, uniqueness and the current pre-log-dedup excerpt limit.

potential_excess.data_scope: Non-error prose and unrelated sensitive details within matching message lines
potential_excess.condition: Any message role can match broad substrings such as failed. Redaction covers selected credential shapes, not arbitrary personal details or every secret representation.
potential_excess.purpose_basis: The hook is intended to capture possible operational errors with short redacted excerpts. Role-unfiltered substring capture and retaining surrounding details are implementation choices.
potential_excess.necessary_behavior: Save enough diagnostic information for useful error triage.
potential_excess.proposed_reduction: Where record structure permits, distinguish actual failures from quoted/example prose and persist a sanitized diagnostic summary containing only relevant error details. This reduces extra content in required capture rather than removing error capture.
potential_excess.preservation_conditions: Retain genuine failures reported outside tool messages, useful reproduction information, candidate uncertainty and provenance. Apply narrowing before persistence rather than erasing existing history.

potential_excess.condition: Every fresh sweep entry includes both fields, outside excerpt redaction and truncation.
potential_excess.purpose_basis: Triage requires locating supporting context; retaining both a raw session key and a full filesystem location is not an explicit entry-document requirement.
potential_excess.necessary_behavior: Keep a usable, scoped link to the supporting transcript.
potential_excess.proposed_reduction: Use a workspace-relative transcript locator where possible; omit the raw session key when the locator suffices, or substitute a minimal opaque identifier. Sanitize any retained metadata.
potential_excess.preservation_conditions: The locator must remain usable, including for externally located transcripts; retain an authorized lookup mechanism when a relative path cannot resolve the source.

potential_excess.condition: User follows the uninstall guide's option to retain bootstrap reminders while disabling only the sweep; archiving is advised first.
potential_excess.purpose_basis: Stopping automatic scanning is a configuration outcome. Deleting captured history is a separate destructive action caused by using directory existence as the sweep gate.
potential_excess.necessary_behavior: Disable transcript scanning while continuing reminder injection.
potential_excess.proposed_reduction: Add a dedicated sweep-enable control and document it instead of directory deletion. This removes an avoidable deletion action, not extra data from a required write.
potential_excess.preservation_conditions: Requires a scoped hook change: no independent switch exists in the supplied implementation. Preserve reminders and existing history, and do not claim the current disable-hook command preserves reminders.

unknowns: Actual enabled hooks, user consent, transcript contents, stored sensitive data, filesystem permissions and deployed configuration are not supplied; occurrence and impact cannot be established.
OpenClaw's runtime selection of handler.ts versus handler.js is unspecified. Their supplied paths implement corresponding behavior; the packaged tests import handler.js.

OpenClaw/model-provider transport, session-tool recipients, installer telemetry, stderr retention and external storage behavior are undocumented here. Local reads and virtual bootstrap injection do not establish a remote disclosure.
Maintenance checks may access remote authorities or exercise dependencies, but their concrete requests, data payloads and recipients depend on future claims and are unresolved.
SKILL.md asserts a default repository ignore policy, but no .gitignore is packaged, so actual exclusion from version control cannot be verified.
SQLite-backed transcript capture is expressly unsupported by this hook; source-only review cannot establish external compatibility. Manual logging remains available.
Evaluation-response storage and archive destinations/retention are unspecified. These limits do not prevent completing the supplied-source audit.
